bounds.statement: agentSteps min 2 max 12 default 8; quietStart 23 quietEnd 9; dailyTurnLimit default 0; timezone Europe/Kyiv; speechVoice default alloy. These are schema defaults, not observed runtime settings.

Ambient source age <=90 s; checked gap 45 s; debounce now+2 s capped created+8 s; related search 12 terms before expansion, 24 after, 8 historical rows, body 1000 chars. Actual preferences can further restrict.
InteractionSpec participant_ids/roles max30, options max12, choices max2; roster >8 defaults to published opt-in list. These are operation/working-set bounds, not a declared group-size limit.

Task executes max2 tool actions per model turn; recent tool results limit12, feedback5; resume extra steps2..16, max_steps cap64 and fresh 30-minute deadline. Need current task fields for actual remaining budget.

Series interval1..12, weekdays1..7, count1..3660; daily/weekly/monthly; DST reject/earlier/later/skip; catch_up latest/ask/skip. Source policy tasks default ask; no inferred automatic execution of missed effects.
Original request max16 KiB /128 native entities; task resume history64. Truncation/unknown cannot revive old approval.

AES-256-GCM; key32 bytes, IV12 bytes; ingress pressure rejects at count>=5000 or bytes>32MiB; retry interval5 s then repair for validation or stored attempts>=4; terminal done/discarded older7d pruned.

Terminal inbox duplicate payload compaction after1 day, batches100; sent duplicate text batches100; expired UI/cache rows batches500; originals_removed=0; receipts/dedup retained. Declared reproducible cache24h or48MiB LRU.

Source loops delivery<=3 concurrent tenants, media<=2, automation<=2. Separately observed Render service metadata: one worker instance, checksPass, pinned SHA live. This does not establish active lease/Auth or real runtime resource usage.
Render deadline180000ms; collection position0..49 (working format bound, not overall accepted asset count).
WEBM max256*1024 bytes, source count120, unique ID/emoji/telegram_emoji/sha256 checks; provider set/membership/order verified by publisher code. This intake did not run publisher.

Один heavy callback; до 8 очікувачів/30 s; browser queue до 4 включно з активною операцією. При відомому ліміті current+reserve <=0.9*limit; reserve192 MiB browser/PDF/DOCX preview,128 MiB інші. Один safe reclaim/recheck; невідомий limit не вигадується. Admission не є allocation cap або гарантією від OOM.

Telemetry default30s, heavy sampling1s; /proc traversal max256 processes, cgroup ancestor traversal max16, read text max65536 chars. source=node_process_only and limit=null when cgroup unavailable; unlimited=null. arrayBuffers already included in external; child count unknown=null. No content/identifiers in log. Sampled peak can miss brief spikes.

At most4 pending including active; serialized browser operations/idle cleanup; idleMs default60000. Last browser context closes browser immediately. Safe pressure reclaim never closes active operation or existing sessions.

Task resource denial → needs_input без автоматичного model-step; claimed effect лишається uncertain і потребує reconcile; media зберігає repair/materials; visual повертається в pending без decode-attempt та із cooldown30 s; cancel/forget/revision fences зберігаються.
Full local design and limits; a clean clone does not carry this file. Hand off unchanged bytes plus hash. No memory guarantee from local macOS pilot; sampled process RSS is not cgroup usage.
